title: Albania wants to be a part of the EU

paragraphs: The Prime Minister of Albania, Edi Rama, says that his country has only one big goal: to join the European Union. Albania started trying to join the EU in 2014, but the process is very slow.

Rama thinks the EU needs to change its rules. He wants candidate countries to sit at the table with EU leaders early, like children in a family, even before they pass all their exams. If the process takes too long, people will lose hope. Then, bad groups and countries like Russia make people hate the EU. Rama gave the example of Moldova, where Russia tries hard to change how people think.
Rama also said that European leaders must start talking to Russia to stop the war in Ukraine because every democratic country needs peace.

paragraphs: Edi Rama is the leader of Albania. He says that his country must become a part of the European Union. There is no other plan for Albania.

Albania wants to be a part of the EU since 2014. But things are too slow. Rama wants the EU to help faster. Candidate countries should sit at the table with big EU states now. If the EU waits too long, bad people and Russia will tell lies to people in Albania. This happens in Moldova. Many people are now afraid and do not like Europe anymore.
Rama also speaks about the war. European leaders must still talk to Russia to stop the war.

paragraphs: Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama stated that there is no alternative for his country to joining the European Union.

He described Albanians as fanatics of the EU faith who have no backup plan. Although Albania has been a candidate country since 2014, the traditional accession process is too slow. Rama supports a new proposal for gradual integration. This would allow candidate countries to sit at the table with EU members and enjoy early benefits before becoming full members.

Rama warned that long delays cause people to lose trust in the EU, which helps anti-EU forces and countries like Russia spread lies in the Western Balkans. He used Moldova as an example, where Russian interference has almost turned public opinion against Europe. Finally, Rama commented on the war in Ukraine. He stated that even though Russia is currently acting as an enemy by killing people, European leaders must start diplomatic talks with Moscow to find a way to stop the war and achieve peace.
